Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ كَانَ قَلَّ زَادِيْ فِيْ الْمَسِيرِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: My God, even if my provisions are scarce for the journey to You
My trust in relying upon You is excellent

Arabic text: وَإِنْ كَانَ جُرْمِيْ قَدْ أَخَافَنِيْ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
Translation: And if my crimes have made me fearful of Your punishment

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ رَجَائِيْ قَدْ أَشْعَرَنِيْ بِالْاَمْنِ مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ
Translation: My hope has given me a sense of security from Your vengeance

Arabic text: وَإِنْ كَانَ ذَنْبِيْ قَدْ عَرَّضَنِيْ لِعِقَابِكَ
Translation: And if my sins have exposed me to Your punishment
My good faith has informed me of Your reward

Arabic text: وَإِنْ أَنَامَتْنِيْ الْغَفْلَةُ عَنِ الِأَسْتِعْدَادِ لِلِقَائِكَ
Translation: And if negligence has put me to sleep from preparing for meeting You

Arabic text: فَقَدْ نَبَّهَتْنِيْ الْمَعْرِفَةُ بِكَرَمِكَ وَ آلَائِكَ
Translation: My knowledge of Your generosity and blessings has awakened me

Arabic text: وَإِنْ أَوْحَشَ مَا بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَكَ فَرْطُ الْعِصْيَانِ وَالطُّغْيَانِ
Translation: And if excessive disobedience and transgression have caused estrangement between me and You
The good news of forgiveness and pleasure has comforted me
I ask You by the glory of Your countenance and by the lights of Your holiness
And I implore You by the compassion of Your mercy
And the subtleties of Your kindness

Arabic text: أَنْ تُحَقِّقَ ظَنِّيْ بِمَا أُؤَمِّلُهُ مِنْ جَزِيلِ إِكْرَامِكَ
Translation: To fulfill my expectations of what I hope for from Your abundant generosity
And Your beautiful blessings in nearness to You
And closeness to You
And the joy of gazing upon You

Arabic text: وَهَا أَنَا مُتَعَرِّضٌ لِنَفَحَاتِ رَوْحِكَ وَعَطْفِكَ
Translation: Here I am, exposing myself to the breezes of Your comfort and kindness
And seeking the rain of Your generosity and gentleness
Fleeing from Your anger to Your pleasure
Running away from You toward You
Hoping for the best of what You have
Depending on Your gifts
In need of Your care

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ مَا بَدَأْتَ بِهِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ فَتَمِّمْهُ
Translation: My God, whatever You have begun of Your grace, complete it

Arabic text: وَمَا وَهَبْتَ لِيْ مِنْ كَرَمِكَ فَلَا تَسْلُبْهُ
Translation: And whatever You have granted me of Your generosity, do not take it away

Arabic text: وَمَا سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَيَّ بِحِلْمِكَ فَلَا تَهْتِكْهُ
Translation: And whatever You have covered of my faults with Your forbearance, do not expose it

Arabic text: وَمَا عَلِمْتَهُ مِنْ قَبِيحِ فِعْلِيْ فَاغْفِرْهُ
Translation: And whatever You know of my shameful deeds, forgive it
My God, I seek Your intercession with Yourself
And I seek Your protection from You
I have come to You eager for Your kindness
Desiring Your favor
Seeking the heavy rain of Your generosity
Requesting the clouds of Your grace
Seeking Your pleasure
Aiming for Your presence
Coming to the fountain of Your support
Seeking the sublime goodness from You
Arriving at the presence of Your beauty
Wanting Your countenance
Knocking at Your door
Humbling myself before Your greatness and majesty

Arabic text: فَافْعَلْ بِيْ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ
Translation: So treat me as You are worthy of, with forgiveness and mercy

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِيْ مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالنّـِقْمَةِ
Translation: And do not treat me as I deserve, with punishment and vengeance
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
